resolution_source_risk: TicketData may not preserve a public, time-stamped historical snapshot of the exact 8:00 PM ET value; the supplied rules name no fallback source.
rationale: This resolves on a future secondary-market ticket-price snapshot, which depends on the aggregate behavior of many independent buyers and sellers through September 7. No specific identifiable group can already know that future value, so this is a rate-and-demand question rather than an insider-knowledge event.
